description_en: Queries the number of DDos attacks on an RDS Custom for SQL Server instance and monitors the security status of the instance in real time to assess potential security risks
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS Custom for SQL Server实例被DDos攻击的数量，实时监控数据库实例的安全状态，以便评估潜在的安全风险
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-rc-instance-ddos-count --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-type ecs --ddos-region-id cn-beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRCInstanceDdosCount

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the RDS Custom instance resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the asset that is assigned a public IP address. Fixed value: ecs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网IP资产的实例类型，固定值ecs
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the asset
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网IP资产所在地域ID
parameters.name: ddos_region_id

DdosCount.description_en: The number of instances that are under DDoS attacks
DdosCount.description_zh: 正在遭受DDoS攻击的实例数量详情

BlackholeCount.description_en: The number of instances for which blackhole filtering is triggered
BlackholeCount.description_zh: 处于黑洞状态的实例的数量

DefenseCount.description_en: The number of instances for which traffic scrubbing is triggered
DefenseCount.description_zh: 正在进行攻击流量清洗的实例的数量
